The '''Bortele Cluster''' was a [[Star cluster/Legends|star cluster]] in the [[Bortele sector/Legends|Bortele sector]], located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="eao" /> It contained the planet [[Ingo/Legends|Ingo]].
